reason: The plugin primarily processes ASCII DXF drawings, extracting structured CAD evidence and applying deterministic project-defined geometry and policy checks through CLI and MCP interfaces.

summaries.zh: 用于检查 ASCII DXF 图纸并依据项目策略生成包含实体、几何、图层和规则问题的结构化证据报告。
summaries.en: Inspects ASCII DXF drawings and produces structured evidence reports covering entities, geometry, layers, and deterministic policy findings.

capabilities: Reads ASCII DXF files relative to a configured workspace root
Parses supported CAD entities and geometric properties
Computes SHA-256 hashes and emits structured inspection evidence
Applies deterministic project-defined CAD review rules
Accepts bounded inline ASCII DXF input through MCP tools
